_source: Computed with tools/alpha_hf.py (ADR 0011); no published counterpart
_alpha_hf_polarised: spin-polarised spherical X-alpha atom (Hund's rule) = ROHF energy of the same configuration
_alpha_hf_recomputed: Schwarz's definition recomputed (spin-restricted X-alpha = HF average-of-configuration energy); a check against the published values, which pyxany uses for 'alpha_hf'
_hf: PySCF ROHF, uncontracted ANO-RCC (+ extended-basis check), non-relativistic
